name: A Bookkeeping Cooperative
description: A worker-owned union cooperative, based in Brooklyn, NY, providing bookkeeping, financial consulting, and financial education to social justice organizations, cooperatives, nonprofits, and individuals working toward economic justice. Offers bilingual (English/Spanish) services and sliding-scale "Solidarity Rates" to keep services accessible, plus workshops on budgeting, accounting fundamentals, and cooperative-specific topics like patronage systems. A New Economy Coalition member organization.

notRepresentable: Most of the public workshop series recurs across multiple weeks. An event here can only carry a single date, so only the one-session Balance Sheet FUNdamentals workshop could be added.
